answer: At Glass Quay booth 17, a courier who wants a noon lane must push a 280 g prism slab into the pulse gate for 11 seconds until the mirror strip prints 9 clean notches, then leave the slab in drawer C for a clerk to weigh. A second watcher later matches the slab serial to booth 17, checks that the notch count stays within 1 of the ticket, and confirms a 0.4 mm frost line at the 70 mm mark. If the pulse gate stays dark, the mirror strip is blank, or two clocks disagree by more than 35 seconds, the bond burns and that courier is barred from the lane board for 13 days.
